records.speaker: Fleet name getter
records.context: Native 36A6C fleet-name getter: no ordinary affiliation and no captain returns unidentified label; captain branch formats pirate prefix with captain name.

records.localization_note: Complete natural American English preserves affiliation uncertainty and pirate identity. Two mapped displays pass 456 native selector/getter/formatter/glyph cases and ten reviewed panels without clipped or dropped characters. Gameplay and other consumers pending.
